2607.24256.title: ML-based Predictive Models for Power Consumption in Virtualised O-RANs
2607.24256.paper_summary: As communication networks adopt virtualized and disaggregated architectures, achieving energy efficiency has become increasingly important for both economic and environmental reasons. Traditional methods for power modeling are inadequate in these dynamic software-defined environments due to their inability to model complex and nonlinear factors affecting energy use. We investigate the use of feature extraction and regressor-based machine learning methods for predicting power consumption in virtualized open radio access networks (O-RANs), utilizing datasets from a hardware-instrumented testbed. We test three variants of deep neural networks (DNNs), namely, a standard DNN, a regularized DNN, and a hybrid model combining DNN-based feature extraction with an XGBoost regressor. We evaluate the performance of these models for various system parameters such as transmission gain, modulation/coding schemes, and airtime. We show that the hybrid model consistently outperformed others, achieving a mean relative error below 0.5%. Results suggest hybrid models like DNN-XGBoost offer superior accuracy and could be integrated into O-RAN management tools to enable more energy-efficient network orchestration in future networks.
2607.24256.paper_summary_zh: 隨著通信網絡採用虛擬化和解耦架構，實現能源效率在經濟和環境方面變得越來越重要。由於傳統的功率建模方法無法建模影響能源使用的複雜和非線性因素，因此在這些動態的軟體定義環境中顯得不夠充分。我們研究了使用特徵提取和基於回歸器的機器學習方法來預測虛擬化開放無線接入網絡（O-RANs）的功耗，並利用來自硬體儀器測試平台的數據集。我們測試了三種深度神經網絡（DNN）的變體，即標準DNN、正則化DNN和結合DNN特徵提取與XGBoost回歸器的混合模型。我們評估了這些模型在不同系統參數下的性能，如傳輸增益、調變/編碼方案和空中時間。我們顯示出混合模型在表現上始終優於其他模型，實現了低於0.5%的平均相對誤差。結果表明，像DNN-XGBoost這樣的混合模型提供了更高的準確性，並可以集成到O-RAN管理工具中，以實現未來網絡中更具能源效率的網絡編排。
